decisions.reason: Correcting the depicted author's identity and photo source does not change the existing photo shape or size requirements.
The source decision identifies where to obtain correct author photos, not a change to the established source for article content.
Replacing an incorrect author photo does not modify the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The author-photo correction does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable or its format.
Selecting the correct author's photo is an identity correction and does not alter the requirement to enhance image quality when necessary.
The author-photo correction does not affect the deferred print-ready deliverable, resolution, or prepress settings.
Using the correct author photos does not change the requirement to create a magazine layout template.
The linked author-photo source is unrelated to flipbook platform selection, cost, or branding workflow.
The author-photo correction does not change the issue's edition, month, or date label.
